read.en: TSMC fell 10.8% on Nov 5 to $353.10, trading between $351.19 and $380.78 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($391.7), 10-day ($411.0), 30-day ($435.1) and 100-day ($428.2) averages and the rising 200-day ($401.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($434.08), and RSI is 26, oversold.
read.zh: 台积电 11月5日下跌 10.8%，收于 $353.10，盘中区间 $351.19–380.78，成交量明显放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$391.7）、10 日（$411.0）、30 日（$435.1）和 100 日均线（$428.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$401.2）下方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$434.08），RSI 为 26，处于超卖区。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $386–388.8, $381.3 and $372.7 supports, all now resistance, leaving a gap from $380.8 to $391.6. Resistance is $372.7, then $380.8–382.2 (Nov 5 high, Jul 28 low, Apr 14 high) and $386–388.8. Support is $350.5–351.2 (Nov 5 low, Mar 25 high), then $335.7–338.6 (Apr 6–7 lows) and $325.2–325.4. A close above $372.7 would target $381–382; below $350.5, $336–339.
